I'm an organized and creative marketing professional with proven experience across a diverse group of organizations — from hotel events and telecom customer service to real estate marketing and mental health practice growth. Along the way I've picked up genuine range: graphic design, email outreach, lead generation, content planning, and the day-to-day admin that keeps a client's business running smoothly.

Most recently, I've worked as a virtual assistant and social media manager for U.S.-based businesses — planning content calendars, designing visuals, managing inboxes, and handling outbound calls — while based abroad in Armenia. I like the mix: strategic enough to plan a campaign, hands-on enough to schedule the post, answer the DM, and follow up with the client myself.
